_doc: v03-local gauntlet spec for the obsidian-knight mount. A chunkier variant of pilots/hand_v2.json (frozen): the palm is thicker/wider and the finger radii are enlarged so the posed fist is a SOLID single component under proprio's conservative (overlap-only) fusion predictor -- the frozen hand's fingers sit at 92% of the palm and only mesh-fuse via blend, which the mesh-free predictor deliberately does not count. body.py's mount search prefers this v03 copy over the pilots original.
